description.narrative:
Project-Level Outcome: Improved access to green finance, blue finance and finance to SMEs, including W-SME: IFC anticipates that the Project will enable Golomt Bank to increase its commitment to sustainable development by i) expanding its lending through sustainable loan products, including supporting green buildings and energy efficiency projects; and ii) pioneering the development and growth of the blue finance in Mongolia through funding eligible water supply and sanitation projects. Furthermore, IFC anticipates that the Project will enable Golomt Bank to expand lending to SMEs, including W- SMEs.
Market-Level Outcome: Sustainability: Via innovation, demonstration replication and capacity building channels, the Project is expected to promote sustainability by helping develop the blue finance market amongst emerging market countries in Asia. In addition, the Project will support the development of the climate finance market by channeling funding to underserved segments in Mongolia.

The proposed investment entails a 3-year senior debt facility to Golomt Bank JSC (the Bank or Golomt Bank) of up to US$150 million, which comprises (a) IFCs A Loan of up to US$100 million; and (b) up to US$50 million to be mobilized through B1/Parallel Loans from other investors. IFCs A Loan will be committed in multiple tranches. At least 60% of the proceeds of the financing package is targeted to finance eligible green assets (including blue assets), and no less than 25% of the total proceeds will be used to finance eligible blue assets. The rest of the proceeds will be used to support the Banks loans to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) including women-owned SMEs (W-SMEs). At least 30% of the loan proceeds will be used to finance W-SMEs (the Project).
